name: IN THE SHADOW OF GREAT WINGS
legend: The enemy are engulfed in a soul-deep shadow for just a moment, as though mighty wings have spread above them and marred their vision with occluding darkness.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has:
  • Stealth.
  • -3" detection range.

name: INSTANT OF GRACE
legend: In this most desperate moment of need, a lone battle-brother rises to the challenge as a true inheritor of the Angel’s legacy.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has CHARACTER until the start of your next Command phase.

name: STRIKE NOW FOR GLORY
legend: Knowing instinctively that the pivotal moment has arrived, these battle-brothers aim and hammer their foes with unrelenting volleys.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

name: UNTO THE BURNING SKIES
legend: In the face of encroaching doom, as the world seems to burn around them, these scions of Sanguinius leap high into the tormented heavens, ready to strike down with vengeful fury upon the enemy teeming below.
description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly The Sanguinor/unengaged Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

name: MEASURED STRATEGIST
legend: Stern and level-headed, this Blood Angels commander is a beacon of composure amidst the tempest of his brothers’ fury, providing much-needed tactical guidance for his impetuous battle-brothers.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: FOCUSED FURY
legend: Keeping the beast within under tight control, the Blood Angels nonetheless tap into that inner rage and shackle it to their precisely aimed blows.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks:
  • Have [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: If your unit is a Character unit, have [LETHAL HITS], [LANCE].

name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

name: DUTY IN DEATH
legend: Imminent death does not prevent a Space Marine from enacting their final justice upon the Emperor’s foes.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if the assault doctrine is active for your unit:
  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

name: GENE-WROUGHT MIGHT
legend: Space Marines are blessed with incredible strength.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have:
  • [Lance].
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, [Lance] and +1 AP.

name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
legend: Kraken rounds utilise adamantine cores and improved propellants to penetrate the thickest hide.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks:
  • Have +6" R.
  • Have +1 S.

name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
legend: Hellfire rounds douse their targets in voracious acids that are utterly lethal to organic life.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

name: SITE-TO-SITE TELEPORTATION
legend: Site-to-site battlefield teleportation is a rare capability indeed, used only by the Deathwatch in extreme situations.
description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT:
  • Place your unit in strategic reserves.
  • If your unit has Kill Team, your unit has Deep Strike until the end of your next Movement phase.

name: ADAPTIVE TACTICS
legend: Only a truly versatile approach to warfare allows the tactical genius of the Deathwatch to best the myriad xenos foes they face.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
legend: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks:
  • Can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
  • Have [IGNORES COVER].

legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

name: EXEMPLARY VIGILANCE
legend: Long have the Ultramarines guarded both Ultramar and the wider Imperium. No foe can hide from their vengeful gaze or evade the reach of their wrath.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

name: COURAGE AND HONOUR!
legend: Roaring their famed battle cry, the Ultramarines hurl themselves into the fight, striving all the harder to prevail beneath the unwavering eye of their Chapter Master.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].

name: PRACTICAL TACTICS
legend: After rapidly making a theoretical assessment of the foes’ probable next moves, the Ultramarines apply practical repositioning to counter them.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

name: TACTICAL FORESIGHT
legend: With the enemy’s countermeasures and responses predicted and allowed for in advance, the Ultramarines can weather their most ferocious attacks.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

name: ULTRAMARIAN ADAPTIVITY
legend: No Chapter’s warriors know better the breadth - theoretical and practical - of the Codex Astartes’ teachings, and how these can and should be adapted to ensure victory.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: IN THE EMPEROR’S NAME
legend: Space Marines will suffer any hardship and endure the savagery of the most monstrous foes to see their duty done.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker and was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

name: CERAMITE BULWARK
legend: The Space Marines present a wall of ceramite and plasteel shoulder guards to the breach as they force passage through.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.

name: VOX-AMPLIFIED ROAR
legend: In the echoing confines of a voidship, the deafening battle cries of the Space Marines evoke terror in the foe.
description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army declares a charge.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Each target of that charge must take a Battle-shock test.

name: DUTY AND DEFIANCE
legend: Even when wounded unto death, still the Adeptus Astartes fight on in hopes their final efforts will spell the difference between defeat and victory.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the Battleline keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

name: EVASIVE REPOSITIONING
legend: Codex doctrine when conducting an aggressive defence is to swiftly take up new positions whenever the foe finds your range.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.

EFFECT:
  • Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
  • Or: If your unit is entrenched, your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Your unit is not able to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

name: ESTABLISH SUPREMACY
legend: Steadfast and determined, the Imperial Fists favour methodical advances, securing and consolidating positions to establish battlefield dominance before turning their attention to the elimination of remaining foes.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

Designer’s Note: This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.

name: PRIORITY STRIKE
legend: Eliminating key enemy assets is crucial to stalling then reversing the foe’s momentum.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.

name: AUGMENTED TARGETING
legend: Auto-sense targeting subroutines specially adapted for defensive fire patterns aid these warriors’ aim.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
  • Or: If your unit is entrenched, [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

name: STAND TO THE END
legend: Aware of how vital it is that the defence line holds, these warriors fight even to their last breath.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT:
  • Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
  • Or: If your unit is entrenched, attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

name: UNYIELDING MIGHT
legend: Knowing that this strategically vital site must be secure for the defence lines to hold, Space Marines stand indomitable in the face of the foe.
description:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

name: BIRTH OF A SAGA
legend: Heroes are forged in the heat of battle, rising from obscurity to become the warriors of epic sagas.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units).

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has CHARACTER.

name: HEROIC RESOLVE
legend: This warrior’s indomitable fortitude is the stuff of legend, galvanizing his pack to remain standing before an avalanche of incoming attacks.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

name: CHAMPION'S GUIDANCE
legend: A paragon of Fenrisian savagery, this champion guides his warriors with confidence and precision.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

name: WINGS OF SHADOW
legend: Through subtle manoeuvring and empowered cameleoline armour, the swiftest of the Ravenwing evade attempts to bring their hunt to an end.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Ravenwing Fly/Mounted unit.

TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Stealth.

name: SKYBORNE SURVEILLANCE
legend: The auspicators of the Ravenwing are sleepless, and from ideal hunting vantages, there is nowhere the foe can hide for long.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Ravenwing Fly unit has shot.

TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit.

EFFECT: Visible enemy units within 6" of your unit have +3" detection range.

name: WE ARE VENGEANCE
legend: The Ravenwing's aerial assets are capable of swift and reactive manoeuvring to new firing positions, ensuring opportunities for rapid vengeance.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Ravenwing Fly unit has shot.

TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

name: BLACKSTAR EXTRACTION
legend: Swooping low with transport bays yawning wide, Corvus Blackstar gunships extract Deathwatch warriors from the battlefield and convey them to locations where their lethal talents are most required.
description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
legend: Space Marines’ incredible battlefield awareness enables them to instinctively identify the origin of any enemy fire and punish their attackers.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

name: STORM OF FIRE
legend: There is no escaping the wrath of the Space Marines, and they use their weapons to bring swift death to their foes wherever they may hide.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • [Ignores Cover].
  • Or: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, [Ignores Cover] and +1 AP.

name: INEXORABLE VALOUR
legend: Ever reaching for the heights of exemplary valour instilled in their forebears by Sanguinius, the golden host seize every opportunity to claim positions from which to strike anew.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit ends a fall-back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

name: JUDGEMENT OF THE GOLDEN HOST
legend: The meteoric impact of the Sanguinary Guard is an unavoidable judgement on those who have incurred the Chapter's wrath.
description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit form your army ends a charge move.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

name: BLINDING BLURS OF VENGEANCE
legend: When they power forward in rapid leaps, the glare emitted by their jump packs' nacelles reflecting from the mirrored gleam of their armour, the Sanguinary Guard seem to glow with a blinding radiance few can look upon.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has:
  • Stealth.
  • -3" detection range.

name: DOCTRINAL FLEXIBILITY
legend: For all their zealous fury, the Black Templars are Space Marines still, capable of adapting their strategies in the midst of battle to ensure the foe’s destruction.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Crusader Squad unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: AVOWED DESTRUCTION
legend: The Black Templars will see their oaths upheld at any cost. Any foe with the temerity to impede them in this goal must be put mercilessly to the sword.
description:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks:
  • Have [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

name: ANGELS DEFIANT
legend: All too aware of their vital role in holding the foe at bay, these battle-brothers refuse to yield to even the most grievous of wounds.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

name: WRATH AND RUIN
legend: Having drawn their enemies in, Space Marine battle-brothers fall back and open fire at point-blank range before thundering forward to put any survivors to death.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

EFFECT: The assault doctrine or tactical doctrine is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.

name: BLAZING EARTH
legend: When faced with an onrushing horde, the Forgefather’s warriors set fire to the earth beneath their feet, impeding their advance and throwing them into confusion.
description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more Torrent/Melta weapons.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

name: IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS
legend: Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1 AP.

name: BURNING VENGEANCE
legend: To open fire on warriors of the Salamanders is merely to invite one’s own swift destruction.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can:
  • Make a disembark move.
  • Shoot using normal shooting, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
legend: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6".

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can:
  • Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

name: FORGED IN FIRE
legend: The Salamanders are masters of the flamer, wielding such weapons with supreme precision and utilising them even in the press of melee combat.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Torrent weapons:
  • Do not have [Blast].
  • Have [Close-Quarters].
  • Have +1 A.

name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
legend: There is no time to rest upon laurels while any portion of the Emperor’s realm remains in enemy hands.
description:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

name: STORM AND SECURE
legend: The advanced mechanised assault tactics employed by this force allow ground to be seized rapidly while on the move.
description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit that has an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit embarked within it.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
legend: Bursting out of their transport, the Space Marines are already on the move before their foes can react.
description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a Transport is selected to move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
legend: Masters of the art of long-ranged warfare, these warriors unleash utter devastation upon their enemies.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
legend: Space Marines know precisely when to give ground to leave enemies floundering, before surging back and driving them from the field in disarray.
description:

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

name: A WORTHY DEATH
legend: Those Space Marines who specialise in close assault are ready to fight to their last breath and beyond to cut down more foes.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

name: MIGHT OF ANGELS
legend: Relentless assault training allows these warriors to focus their already impressive might into a truly devastating close-quarters onslaught.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].

name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
legend: The tenets of the Codex Astartes allow for unorthodox use of combat tactics and the employment of divergent doctrines if doing so will lead to victory.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: ARMOURED IMPACT
legend: Throwing their armoured mass into an assault, a Space Marine in Gravis armour can crush and trample their foe.
description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Gravis unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
legend: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Gravis unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits].

name: PURGATION PUSH
legend: Gravis assault tactics stipulate a relentless advance coupled with unfaltering firepower.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Gravis unit has shot.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT:
  • If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an objective.
  • Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a Transport until the end of the turn.

name: SUPPRESSION VOLLEYS
legend: Laying down hails of heavy fire, these warriors pin or drive back the foe.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Gravis unit has shot.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

name: STAND UNYIELDING
legend: Ground claimed by Gravis-clad Adeptus Astartes cannot be taken back with ease.
description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly Gravis unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
legend: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Gravis unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits].

name: WRATH OF THE LION
legend: Channelling the strategic puissance and measured ferocity of their gene-sire, the veterans of the Unforgiven unleash a perfectly timed and utterly lethal storm of tightly controlled violence.
description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Deathwing unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That DEATHWING unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
legend: So driven by duty are the veterans of the Unforgiven that even death cannot keep them from it.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Deathwing unit.

TARGET: That DEATHWING unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is engaged with an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective:
  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

name: RELIC TELEPORTARIUM
legend: The Deathwing employ ancient and incredibly powerful teleportariums, some older than the Great Crusade, to strike at their foes with unparalleled safety and accuracy.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Deathwing unit with the Deep Strike ability is selected to make an ingress move.

TARGET: That DEATHWING unit.

EFFECT:
  • Your unit can be set up more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units (instead of more than 8").
  • Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of this turn.

name: ADAMANTINE TERROR
legend: Booming war cries through his vox-amplifiers, this Dreadnought rampages through the terrified foe.
description:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly Dreadnought unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

name: UPSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
legend: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the relentless advance of an Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Dreadnought unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
legend: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Dreadnought unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [lethal hits].
  • Or: [Sustained Hits 1].

name: MIGHT OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
legend: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crews of their vehicles are slain.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units).

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • M.
  • BS.
  • Hit rolls and wound rolls.

name: LAYERED CERAMITE
legend: The labours of artisans in the Chapter armoury now bear fruit.
description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

name: HEADHUNTER DOCTRINE
legend: Exhaustive tactical training aids Space Marine gunners in exploiting any weakness in their targets’ armour.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units) is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

name: SLAYERS OF ABOMINATIONS
legend: The largest manifestations of the foe's sin are branded unholy abominations, challenges which a crusade's champions gladly meet to drive their sanctified weapons deeply beneath their hides.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.

name: UNSPARING EXECUTION
legend: Those who attempt to flee their rightful death only stroke their executioners' hatred all the hotter. None can be spared the God-Emperor's wrath.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move , that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode, with -1 to those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

name: BLADE OF DETESTATION
legend: With roared litanies and incendiary hatred, the Sword Brethren plunge into their foe like a white-hot blade, their armoured momentum cracking armour, crushing bones, and trampling the foe underfoot.
description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

name: VENGEFUL ANIMUS
legend: Carefully cogitated binharic prayers can focus a machine spirit’s ire into near-obsessive hatred of its slayers, ensuring that vengeance is meted out even in death.
description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit is destroyed, before rolling for deadly demise.

TARGET: That friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Change any deadly demise rolls made for this unit to an unmodified 6.

name: SPIRITS OF IRON
legend: These warriors emulate the mechanical monstrosities at whose side they fight, shrugging off wounds both physical and spiritual.
description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel no pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

name: ANCIENT FURY
legend: The heroes entombed within Dreadnoughts have fought across countless war zones throughout their extended existences, perfecting their martial prowess beyond mortal limits.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has:
  • +1" M.
  • +1 T.
  • +1 Ld.
  • +1 OC.
  • +1 to hit rolls.

name: UNBOWED CONVICTION
legend: Space Marines exemplify obdurate tenacity. Even severely injured, they will never abandon their oaths.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is below starting strength.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • BS and WS.
  • Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

name: POWER OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
legend: There are many tales of machine spirits wreaking havoc on the foe, even after the crew of their vehicle are slain and critical systems are failing.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using:
  • Snap shooting.
  • Or: If your unit is at half-strength/below half-strength, normal shooting.
While doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

name: METHODICAL BRUTALITY
legend: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

SECONDARY EFFECT:
  • If your unit is a VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.

name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
legend: At an opportune moment, Space Marine infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Phobos/Scout SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

name: MORTIS SNARES
legend: These stealth operatives lace the battlefield with explosive devices that trigger by mico-auspex and las-wire when foes blunder into them.
description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Phobos/Scout Squad unit.

EFFECT: If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6:
  • On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.
  • That objective is no longer snared.

name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
legend: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden Phobos unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • [Lethal Hits].

name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
legend: To evade one’s enemies and sow confusion can be a deadly weapon in itself.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden Phobos unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • [Lethal Hits].

name: TRANSHUMAN REACTIONS
legend: Seemingly with the speed of instinct, these warriors reposition in response to the enemy’s movements.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Phobos unit.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
  • Up to D6".
  • Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

name: UMBRAL EVASION
legend: A combination of technological arcana and expert training help these warriors to evade the eyes of the foe.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Phobos unit.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

name: MASTER MARKSMEN
type: Pilum Strike Team – Battle Tactic Stratagem
legend: Every shot these warriors fire is placed for maximum impact and swift, decisive kills.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

name: KNIFE WORK
type: Pilum Strike Team – Battle Tactic Stratagem
legend: These warriors strike at their enemies'weak spots, aiming to silence the foe without raising the alarm.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

name: ENHANCED EFFICIENCY
type: Pilum Strike Team – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
legend: Moving with alacrity, clearing each new space with exceptional speed and skill, the warriors of the strike team advance on their main objective.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, it can attempt to operate one Hatchway it is within 1” of either at the start or end of that move. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.

name: FIGHTING RETREAT
type: Pilum Strike Team – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
legend: These warriors employ cover fire and frag charges to batter the foe as they fall back to new positions.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

name: UNBRIDLED FEROICITY
legend: The Space Wolves fight with a savage fury that enables them to overcome even the most resilient targets.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

name: CO-ORDINATED STRIKE
legend: Space Wolves officers rein in their warriors’ impulsive fury, repositioning them to strike exposed flanks.
description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One unengaged Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

name: IMPETUOSITY
legend: Severe losses only drive Blood Claws and Wulfen forward into the midst of the foe.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen unit has shot.

TARGET: That BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

name: BATTLE INSTINCTS
type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
legend: These champions of Fenris respond to enemy fire with instinctive swiftness, rarely giving their foes a second chance to shoot at them.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

name: GRIMNAR'S COMMAND
type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
legend: Pivotal as they are to the Great Wolf’s plans, this pack have their own orders to fulfil in this moment that come directly from Grimnar himself.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units).

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: FENRISIAN FEROCITY
type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
legend: Even the most challenging terrain or formidable fortifications cannot stop the Great Wolf’s chief hunters once they are in motion.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Walker unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

name: FANGS OF THE PACK
type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
legend: Fighting as one, these champions of Fenris fall upon an enemy champion and drag them down with single-minded savagery.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Precision].

name: WOLF TOTEMS
type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
legend: Be it the power of belief or something a little more eldritch, the Space Wolves’ trust in their various protective amulets and totems is often borne out.
description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

name: EYE OF THE PACK
type: Saga of the Great Wolf Stratagem
legend: Once a pack of Fenrisian warriors has perceived some slight weakness in the defences of a foe, they all strike at once, like encircling predators dragging down their prey.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

name: LAY LOW THE TYRANTS
legend: In a storm of blade thrusts and bludgeoning strikes, enemy champions and commanders are laid low, leaving their troops in leaderless disarray.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Precision].

name: FEINT AND THRUST
legend: Retreating from the fight, these warriors lure their enemies on before swiftly turning the tables and hurling themselves into their now overextended foe.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

EFFECT: The tactical doctrine is active for your unit in addition to any other combat doctrine, until the start of your next Command phase.

name: SUPPRESSED WEAPONS
legend: The Raven Guard commonly utilise integral suppressors, flash-hiders and other technology to dampen weapon reports and conceal muzzle flare, enabling battle-brothers to fire on unsuspecting foes without giving away their positions.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

name: MURDEROUS FUSILLADE
legend: From darkness and obscuring cover, Raven Guard battle-brothers open fire as one, striking their unaware targets with precision fire.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • +1 BS.
  • +1 AP.

name: RAPTORIAL VIGILANCE
legend: The Raven Guard are swift to exploit the movements of their foes, whether to pursue their prey and complete the kill or to make use of an opportunity to fade once more from sight.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
  • Up to D6".
  • Or: If your unit is a Phobos/Scout Squad unit, up to 6".

name: INTO DARKNESS
legend: At the opportune moment, Raven Guard infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.
description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

name: ADAPTIVE PURGE
type: Shield of the Void – Battle Tactic Stratagem
legend: Whatever hidden horrors lurk in the vessels the Shield Chapters must conquer, the warriors are able to adapt their firing tactics to ensure their destruction.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one of the following abilities: [LETHAL HITS], [IGNORES COVER] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability.

name: RAPID TAKEOVER
type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
legend: With one foe reeling in disarray, the battle-brothers instantly refocus on their next target, their rapid yet methodical progress capitalising on the enemy's every move.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+1".

name: OVERCHARGED BREACH
type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
legend: With a well-placed volley of high-powered ammunition or a dedicated melta charge, specially equipped Space Marines can effect a permanent access route.
description:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway within 9" of and visible to your unit. Open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once.

name: CODEX WARFARE
type: Shield of the Void – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
legend: The Codex Astartes is held as a hallowed work of martial genius by the Shield Chapters. Its tenets prescribe tactical adaptability and fighting on the move, advancing from one adversary to the next in a series of deadly redeployments.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

name: FLAWLESS RIDERS
legend: Skilled Space Marine riders can guide their steeds through even the densest and most treacherous terrain to strike their foes from the position they least expect.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes mounted unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

name: SPEAR THRUST AND SABRE SWING
legend: Some foes can be ended with a single charge. Others require sustained savagery to fell. The White Scars are adept at both methods of fighting.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks:
  • Have [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: Have [LANCE].
  • Or: If your unit has Mounted, have [LETHAL HITS] and [LANCE].

name: WITHDRAW AND REGROUP
legend: The riders and pilots sweep away as swiftly as they arrive, regrouping in preparation for their next assault.
description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

name: HUNTER'S INSTINCTS
legend: The White Scars read the ebb and flow of battle with the hungry cunning of raptorial predators, reacting to the enemy’s movements with exceptional rapidity.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted/Speeder unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

name: MOBILE LETHALITY
legend: The White Scars fight their wars at a furious tempo, and their warriors are adept at fire-and-manoeuvre strategies.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT:
  • That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
  • Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

name: EVASIVE MANOEUVERS
legend: Battle-brothers of the White Scars Chapter are born and raised in the saddle. Expert pilots and riders all, they weave through incoming fire with instinctive skill.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
legend: Employing their steeds’ pace to utmost effect, these warriors stay ever on the move.
description:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit that was eligible to fight this phase.

EFFECT:
  • If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move.
  • Or: If your unit is engaged, your unit can make a fall-back move.

name: SUDDEN ONSLAUGHT
legend: Speed and shock are key to the Space Marine way of war: never more so than on rapid-strike missions.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit is selected to make an advance move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can change its advance rolls to a 6.

name: HURTLING TARGETS
legend: With nerves of steel and transhuman reactions, the Space Marines jink and weave cooly through incoming fire.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

name: DOMINATION FIRE
legend: The Codex Astartes dictates when firepower is best used to dismay, disrupt and debilitate the enemy.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
  • While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

name: MASTERFUL TACTICS
legend: Such is the Space Marines’ grasp of adaptive tactics that even the most canny enemies soon find themselves out of position.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
  • Up to D6".
  • Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

name: TACTICAL FOCUS
legend: Even amidst the fiercest fighting, this squad retains sight of their assigned mission.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
legend: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
  • Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

name: TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS
legend: Poised and aware of their foes’ every move, these warriors strike at the most tactically advantageous moment.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.

TARGET: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
legend: Transhuman skill and reaction times render these Space Marines’ firearms as deadly up close as any blade.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged Tacticus unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Blast] attacks) have:
  • [Close-Quarters].
  • [Ignores Cover].

name: FOR THE EMPEROR!
legend: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, battle-brothers seize and hold their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.
description:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
legend: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].
  • Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

name: CLEANSING SWEEP
legend: Refined during the clearance of infested space hulks, these methodical tactics ensure no angle of approach goes undefended.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.

TARGET: One Terminator Squad unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

name: TOWER OF STRENGTH
legend: Each individual Terminator is a walking fortress. When they stand together they are truly indomitable.
description:
WHEN: Start or end of any phase.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.

RESTRICTIONS: Each time you use this Stratagem, you cannot use it again until after your next Command phase.

name: FOCUSING SHRINE
legend: An ancient device built into the structure of the teleportarium, this relic allows for incredibly accurate teleport assaults.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Terminator unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield using its Deep Strike ability, you can set it up unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models (measure this distance as you would normally for the Deep Strike ability, ignoring Walls and closed Hatchways).

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

name: CARVE A PATH
legend: Power fists, chainfists, and sheer servo-actuated armoured mass ensure that Terminators’ paths are never barred for long.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One Terminator Assault Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.

name: TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE
legend: The combination of Tactical Dreadnought armour and transhuman physiology is redoubtable indeed.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

name: MERCILESS VETERANS
legend: Cumulative centuries of military experience help these veterans’ firepower hit home with murderous precision.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
  • [Lethal Hits].
  • [Sustained Hits 1].

name: GUNSHIP EXTRACTION
legend: Armoured gunships are often assigned to swoop in and relocate Terminator Squads in the midst of battle.
description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged adeptus astartes terminator unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

name: FOR THE EMPEROR'S HONOUR!
legend: Filled with the spirit of Sigismund, his heirs seek out the foe’s dark and unclean champions so that they may be crushed in the sight of their thralls.
description:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

name: PIOUS ENMITY
legend: The warrior priests of a crusade drive Sigismund’s heirs into the heart of battle, daring the greatest abominations to face their spiritual strength.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Chaplain/Judiciar unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CHAPLIN/JUDICIAR unit.

EFFECT:
  • Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Or: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

name: DEVOUT PUSH
legend: With a zealous cry, the Black Templars press forward, using their ceramite-armoured bulk to smash into the foe and overwhelm the enemy’s lines.
description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: When making that pile-in/consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

name: HERESY BEGETS RETRIBUTION
legend: Where enemies dare threaten the warriors of the God-Emperor or seek to escape their deserved death, there must be swift retribution.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

name: DREAD CRUSADERS
legend: To face the Emperor’s transhuman crusaders as they chant their litanies of detestation can chill the soul.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets.

TARGET: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase.

EFFECT: That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

name: SPOOR OF THE UNHOLY
legend: Perhaps guided by visions from the Emperor, Black Templars can pick out heresy wherever it lurks.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • BS and WS.
  • Hit rolls.

name: DEATH BEGETS VENGEANCE
legend: With their perceptions twisted, the battle-brothers of the Death Company transmute loss into the worst of ancient betrayals and seek only to sever such treachery from existence.
description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Death Company unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.

TARGET: That enemy unit.

EFFECT: That enemy unit is hated until the end of the battle:
  • While a unit is hated, friendly DEATH COMPANY units’ attacks that target that unit have +1 to wound rolls.

name: NO BARRIER TO RETRIBUTION
legend: Knowing in what remains of his mind that his is a sorrow-filled mission of galactic consequence, this ancient interred warrior permits nothing to stand in his way.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement or your Charge phase, when a friendly Death Company Dreadnought unit is selected to make a normal/advance/charge move.

TARGET: That DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

name: RAGE-FUELLED RESPONSE
legend: They may no longer recognise the foe before them, but the Lost Brethren are sane enough to identify an attack and capable of responding with a violent surge and a howl of wrath.
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Death Company unit has shot.

TARGET: That DEATH COMPANY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

name: IN SACRIFICE, VICTORY
legend: Those inducted into the Dark Angels’ Inner Circle will gladly give their lives in pursuit of victory, and to see the Fallen brought to justice.
description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Deathwing/Ravenwing unit within range of an objective is destroyed.

TARGET: That DEATHWING/RAVENWING unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is destroyed.

EFFECT: Select one objective:
  • That no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT units) are within range of.
  • That your unit was controlling at the end of the previous phase.
That objective is secured.

name: LION'S WILL
legend: Unflinching in their loyalty to Chapter and Primarch, Dark Angels battle-brothers seize and hold their objectives with unrelenting determination and zealous fury.
description:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

name: INESCAPABLE JUSTICE
legend: The Dark Angels are relentless in the pursuit of their foes, striking with ruthless ferocity and precision to take the heads of those who have crossed the Chapter.
description:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That Adeptus Astartes unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have [Precision].

name: TACTICAL MASTERY
legend: When the constituent elements of the Dark Angels fight as one, the enemy is often overwhelmed and torn apart by the Chapter’s tactical flexibility and mastery of rapid warfare.
description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Deathwing/Ravenwing unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: KNIGHTS OF IRON
legend: Atop their snarling mechanical steeds, the warriors of the Ravenwing surge through seemingly impassable terrain, smashing through rubble and ruin to unleash the wrath of the Unforgiven upon unsuspecting targets.
description:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Ravenwing unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That RAVENWING unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

name: RELICS OF THE DARK AGE
legend: Amongst the many secrets hoarded by the Dark Angels are those technological in nature. The armouries of the Rock contain potent weapons unseen in the armouries of other Chapters.
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have +2 S.
